company.name: TechnoSpirit
company.what_we_are: A technology company working across four disciplines that most businesses are forced to buy separately — engineering, design, AI and growth — and that only work properly when they are decided together.
company.what_we_build: The digital infrastructure businesses actually run on. Websites that carry the work. AI that removes the repetition. Growth systems that keep the pipeline full.
company.mission: Help businesses use genuinely powerful technology without inheriting unnecessary complexity.
company.vision: Create digital systems capable of operating, adapting and scaling globally.

disciplines.name: Technology
disciplines.body: Engineering that holds up — architecture, performance, security and the unglamorous parts that decide whether a system lasts.

disciplines.name: Design
disciplines.body: Interfaces built around how people actually read, decide and act. Hierarchy before decoration, always.

disciplines.name: AI
disciplines.body: Automation and agents applied where they remove real work, and deliberately left out where they do not.

disciplines.name: Growth
disciplines.body: Content, campaigns and measurement — so what gets built keeps meeting the people it was built for.

positioning.statement: Three groups of capability that are normally sold by three different companies. Here they are decided together, which is the only way the handoffs stop costing you anything.
positioning.working_style: Built without borders — async by default, documented as we go, and built to work across time zones without waiting for one shared working day.

refusals.title: No invented metrics
refusals.body: We will not quote numbers we cannot show you the source of.

refusals.title: No borrowed logos
refusals.body: Client marks appear on the site when there are clients who have agreed to appear there.

refusals.title: No template resold as custom
refusals.body: If a template genuinely fits, we will say so — and charge accordingly.

refusals.title: No lock-in
refusals.body: You own the code, the accounts and the infrastructure. Always.

refusals.title: No silent handoff
refusals.body: Nothing gets delivered as a zip file and a good-luck message.

web.lead: The part of the business that runs whether or not anyone is at a desk.

entries.name: Website Creation
entries.body: Modern, responsive websites built around how a business actually presents and sells — structure and content decided before styling begins.

entries.name: Responsive Web Design
entries.body: Composed for desktop, laptop, tablet and phone as separate design problems, not one layout squeezed through breakpoints.

entries.name: Website Maintenance
entries.body: Security patching, dependency updates, performance monitoring and ongoing technical support once the site is live.

entries.name: SEO
entries.body: Technical and on-page search optimisation — semantics, performance, crawlability and content structure — for durable organic visibility.

entries.name: Website Dashboard
entries.body: A private control surface for the people running the business: analytics, user activity, content management, reports and business statistics in one place.

entries.name: Custom Web Solutions
entries.body: When an off-the-shelf product would mean changing how the business works, we build the system around the operation instead.

ai.lead: Applied where it removes real work — and deliberately left out where it does not.

entries.name: AI Tools Integration
entries.body: Modern AI capability connected into the workflows and tools a team already uses, rather than added as another place to log in.

entries.name: Custom AI Automation
entries.body: Repetitive operational work — triage, routing, drafting, data entry, follow-up — moved into systems that run without supervision.

entries.name: AI Voice Calling Agents
entries.body: Agents that handle real conversations on the phone, in both directions, and escalate to a person the moment that is the right call.

entries.name: Voice Agent Dashboards
entries.body: Everything the agent did, reviewable: what was said, what it concluded, and what it produced.

entries.name: AI Chatbots
entries.body: One assistant across the website, WhatsApp and messaging platforms — same knowledge, same tone, available continuously.

growth.lead: Building it is half the job. Being found is the other half.

entries.name: Social Media Management
entries.body: Strategy, content production, scheduling and audience development held to one consistent brand voice across channels.

entries.name: Meta Ads
entries.body: Facebook and Instagram campaigns built for lead generation, then actively managed and optimised against what converts.

entries.name: Content Creation
entries.body: Graphics, video, captions and advertising creative produced as an ongoing system rather than one-off assets.

process.name: Discover
process.body: What the business needs to do, who it is for, and what is currently in the way.

process.name: Design
process.body: Structure, hierarchy and interface — decided before a line of production code exists.

process.name: Engineer
process.body: Built with performance, accessibility and future change treated as requirements.

process.name: Test
process.body: Devices, breakpoints, edge cases and real-world conditions before anyone else sees it.

process.name: Launch
process.body: Deployed, instrumented and handed over with the documentation to run it.

process.name: Evolve
process.body: Measured, maintained and extended — because launch is a milestone, not a finish line.

why_us.title: Custom solutions
why_us.body: Nothing is a theme with the colours changed. The system gets shaped to how the business actually operates.

why_us.title: Modern engineering
why_us.body: Current tooling, current standards, and code written to be read by whoever inherits it.

why_us.title: Exceptional UI/UX
why_us.body: Interface quality treated as product quality. Hierarchy, legibility and flow decided deliberately.

why_us.title: AI-first development
why_us.body: Automation considered at design time, not retrofitted.

why_us.title: Performance
why_us.body: Measured, budgeted and defended. Fast is a feature that every other feature depends on.

why_us.title: Scalability
why_us.body: Architected for the traffic and the team you are heading toward, so growth is a configuration change rather than a rebuild.

why_us.title: Security awareness
why_us.body: Dependencies, access, data handling and update discipline treated as ongoing responsibilities.

why_us.title: SEO awareness
why_us.body: Semantics, structure, performance and crawlability built in from the first commit.

why_us.title: Responsive communication
why_us.body: You know what stage the work is in, what is blocked, and what is next. Silence is not part of the process.

why_us.title: Global-ready workflow
why_us.body: Async by default, documented as we go, built to work across time zones.

why_us.title: Long-term support
why_us.body: We stay responsible for what we build. Maintenance, iteration and the second year are part of the conversation from the start.

principles.title: Design for humans.
principles.body: Every interface is used by someone in a hurry, on a bad connection, halfway through something else. That is the default we design for.

principles.title: Engineer for scale.
principles.body: Decisions get made against where the system is going, not only where it is on launch day.

principles.title: Automate the repetitive.
principles.body: If a person does it the same way twice a day, it belongs in software.

principles.title: Build for outcomes.
principles.body: Features are a means. The measure is whether the business can do something it could not do before.

principles.title: Think beyond launch.
principles.body: Shipping is the point at which the real feedback starts. We plan for the second year, not just the first week.
